units.text: Component c1: Two ESCAPADE spacecraft launched from Florida on November 13, 2025, aboard a New Glenn rocket is substantially supported. Span 7 confirms launch date, location, and vehicle; spans 8 and 84-95 confirm both spacecraft achieved communication after launch. Limitations note the count 'two'/

judgement.reason: The passages confirm a November 13, 2025 launch from Florida aboard a New Glenn rocket, but they do not state that two ESCAPADE spacecraft were launched or that both achieved communication after launch.

units.text: Component c2: Launch aboard New Glenn is supported. Span 7 explicitly states the ESCAPADE spacecraft launched aboard a Blue Origin New Glenn rocket; spans 43-66 and 103-105 further confirm New Glenn as the launch vehicle for the twin ESCAPADE spacecraft.

judgement.reason: The NASA SVS title and text support ESCAPADE launching aboard a New Glenn rocket, but the Rocket Lab passages only mention Escapade and dates, not New Glenn or twin spacecraft, so the claim that those spans further confirm it is unsupported.

units.text: Component c3: Mission launched for NASA is supported. Span 7 states the ESCAPADE mission launched for NASA; spans 45, 55, 75, 85, 95, 105 describe mission objectives under NASA sponsorship. No span indicates a different sponsoring agency.

judgement.reason: The passages identify ESCAPADE as NASA's mission under the NASA SIMPLEx program and give its launch details, with no passage naming a different sponsoring agency.
